title: Gold&Blood
description: This mod adds a system of trading “magical substances” in a fantasy world to Minecraft. Players can grow, process, and trade various ingredients within the game. The main goal is to manage resources, develop your own business, and explore the world.
body:
## Guide for Growing and Selling Crops

**Step 1: Find Seeds**

To grow plants, you need to search the grass for seeds that can be planted on a farm plot.
**![vegetables in the garden](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f06c6175355b4c383a4c8d831e8a258ee0276318.png)**

**Step 2: Growing and Drying**

When the crop matures, its quality may be low. After that, you need to dry it.
![Dryer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5038b0d9496bb3d30b7410800bb9843311a94648.png)
![Dryer craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dc11a70721c1a6b47070ff7a979816509c81491.png)

**Step 3: Packaging the Product**

Once the crop is dried, you need to pack it into a bag.
![packaging](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e77e0a0a7d99072a57dbcf7fdae73d6bbcb1fdfe.png)
![Craft baggie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df1180c3b798ba0039c7914c459a4c6a998dc53c.png)

**Step 4: Selling to Villagers**

Take the finished product to villagers. Not all villagers will buy your product — some are picky about quality.
![fish](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfcfabdd8590f5107c3f4f07ac575a82b0149af9.png)
![sell product](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed627f8eea8ff820a36997d54b8f4ebfa3c9f3ae.png)


If you have a large amount of product, you can craft it into blocks for easier storage.
![craft_block1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3711bdc3d1fda70fefd562bae9ade9f25930b6b1.png)
![craft block2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df32aafa997476469d08b1d04337c60d08cd08a7.png)
